body:
## Goal
The repository installs and runs an empty test suite.

## Files touched
- pyproject.toml
- tests/test_smoke.py

## Details
Create pyproject.toml declaring the package name, the src layout and pytest as the only dev dependency, per the Setup section of the README. Add tests/test_smoke.py containing one test that asserts True, so the runner is proven before any feature depends on it.

## Acceptance criteria
pytest -q tests/test_smoke.py
title: Create the package skeleton and test runner
